notes: v535 — strength is now measured across DAYS, not across individual fires (with the matching server update). Two hundred shares firing the same flag on one morning is ONE piece of evidence about that morning, not two hundred — they all rise and fall together. Counting them separately made everything look more certain than it was. The app now averages each day first, then asks how consistent the days were. Some borderline lines will lose their PROMISING badge because of this, and that is the point: they had not earned it. Lesson 50 explains it in plain English. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
